subject: PHYSICS
courseName: Physics Lab for Scientists and Engineers II

response.courseDescription: 212 Physics Lab for Scientists and Engineers II Calculus-based physics lab; topics in electricity, magnetism, electromagnetics, circuits, optics, reflection, refraction, interference, diffraction, polarization; heavy emphasis on group work.
response.coursePrerequisites: PHYSICS 202 or concurrent enrollment; PHYSICS 201 with a C or better or PHYSICS 205 with a C or better; MATH 172 with a C or better or MATH 182 with a C or better.
